items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Albert Burbank sings the A La Ba very well... [INTERVIEWEE] That's the original one that I composed.

ctx.x: That's what it goes, you see? You know how it is with the bands of today, they take a separate piece and they make their own improvisions on it. They make their own improvisions. And I know the minute they get a hold of that, you see, they started making the improvisions on it out of this world and I know it to make it.

Albert Burbank sings the A La Ba very well, you know, the other A La Ba. And D.D. Pierce used to sing that a lot, a trumpet player. I never heard of it, how they sing it. It's just A La Ba. That's the one, yeah. Not like the one you played.
That's the original one that I composed. And it's fall back, let's see. That happened anywhere between 1912, between 1910 and 1914.
